decision: work in fork AojdevStudio/cua, branch ossie/selfhost, clone at aojdevmac-m5:~/code/cua

decision: iPhone reaches the bot over Tailscale, not the cua.ai relay
why: relay cannot publish a bot Space yet (upstream gap) and needs a cua.ai account; iphone183 is on the tailnet

decision: registered bundle id studio.aoj.cuabots (ASC id 35R987GD8G), matching the studio.aoj.* prefix of Ossie's other apps
why: TestFlight needs a bundle id on Ossie's team

decision: app record cannot be created by agent: ASC API refuses apps CREATE, no Xcode Apple ID, no live ASC browser session
why: creating it needs Ossie's Apple ID 2FA; will finish build, signing and upload script so his step is one click plus one command
evidence: ASC 403 'apps does not allow CREATE'; Chrome cookies have no myacinfo

why: local Spaces need Docker after a reboot; OrbStack, never Docker Desktop

decision: patched Keyvault.swift, WorkViews.swift, Sheets.swift to the current KvItem fields (domain, key, app_display)
why: the sample did not compile against the staged Cua Spaces export: KvItem has no label, account or site

decision: persist the agent event cursor per run ID in the store state
why: after a restart the app polled from 0 and showed Obi's last reply again
evidence: commit 68765986; testRestartDoesNotRepeatAFinishedTurn failed before, passes after; 23 tests pass

decision: add SelfHost.swift: CUA_BOTS_SEED creates Obi once, CUA_BOTS_SHOW_COMPUTER opens its computer, SIGUSR1 writes a snapshot and the pairing links
why: a headless Mac has nobody to click New bot, and ssh screencapture fails without a Screen Recording grant

decision: snapshot with ScreenCaptureKit SCShareableContent.currentProcess, matched to the main NSWindow
why: screencapture from ssh and from a launchd agent both fail: could not create image from display; the first snapshot caught a stream surface, so match by window number

decision: CUA_BOTS_PAIRING_HOST swaps 127.0.0.1 for aojdevmac-m5.tail3a79a5.ts.net in the pairing link, port kept
why: the phone needs a host it can reach; same port number keeps the forward rule simple

decision: forward spacesd with tailscale serve --tcp P to 127.0.0.1:P, reconciled on docker start and die events
why: cua-vmm publishes spacesd on 127.0.0.1 with a random host port; tailscale serve listens only on the tailnet; event driven, not polling
evidence: ossie/logs/proof/out-listeners.log: 127.0.0.1 and 100.98.3.78 only; out-reach.log: LAN refused

decision: run the app from ~/.local/share/cua-bots, copied by ossie/install-runtime.sh
why: the first deploy hung: bash blocked in open() on /Volumes/Lexar waiting on a Removable Volumes prompt nobody can click
evidence: bgjob deploy 1 health check failed; sample of bash in __open_nocancel; deploy 2 healthy

decision: bgjob com.obi.cua-bots: user scope, run_at_load, keep_alive, LimitLoadToSessionType Aqua, health pgrep CuaBots
why: bgjob has no GUI app type, but a gui/<uid> LaunchAgent with Aqua session type starts a windowed app at login

decision: read CLIPROXYAPI_KEY_CUABOTS with hush at start, BWS token from ~/.env
why: the key must never sit in a file or plist; launchd has no shell rc
capture.sh turns it off too; a personal self-host should not send usage data by default

decision: Obi's standing instructions come from the sample's own template with owner Ossie
why: the template already says You are Obi, Ossie's bot, a persistent assistant; no custom prompt needed
evidence: reply: I'm Obi (@ossie-obi), and I work for Ossie.

decision: did not reboot the M5 to test login start
why: a reboot would cut the parallel iOS agent's build on the same box
evidence: autoLoginUser aojadmin, FileVault Off, RunAtLoad true
